rule.gaussian_prefix: Exact SHA256 of all original latent Gaussian knots.
rule.scalar_and_profile: Every original numeric field at every original saved time, with no field interpolation; all original fields must remain present.
rule.coupled_state: Every species and Spring circumference at the original horizon, read from the exact shared full-state checkpoint time.
rule.interpretation: Numerical evolution equivalence, not bitwise identity at the original stopping cap. Missing or failed checks exclude long-arm qualification and never substitute the original shorter run.

census_receipt: retained_native_prefix_equivalence:{path,sha256}; retained_prefix records exact old seed/status/audit/horizon and Gaussian hash; new_gaussian_path distinguishes retained continuations from additional independent seeds.
failure_handling: Native integration completeness is recorded separately from native validation. Any failed prefix check fails the worker qualification and prevents long-arm completeness. Raw native fields and failure evidence are preserved; no shorter-run substitution.
